description.zh:
服务状态，可选值为：
-  IN_SERVICE：服务中。
- PAUSED：服务暂停。
description.en:
Service status. Valid values:
- IN_SERVICE: in service.
- PAUSED: pause.

descriptions.zh:
您可以更新服务空间的描述信息，您还可以更新服务空间的服务状态。当服务状态设置为PAUSED（服务暂停）时，服务面（包含小程序端访问服务空间和静态网站托管服务）不再提供服务，管控面（使用OpenAPI或者控制台）提供正常服务。

> 更新服务空间状态成功到状态完全生效有一定的延迟，最高不超过10分钟。
descriptions.en:
You can update the description of a service space and also update its service status. When the service status is set to PAUSED (service paused), the data plane—which includes miniapp access to the service space and static website hosting—no longer provides service, while the control plane—accessed via OpenAPI or the console—continues to operate normally.

> After successfully updating the service space status, it may take some time for the new status to take full effect, with a maximum delay of 10 minutes.
